name: nextjs-dictionary-api
description: Next.js Dictionary API Demo using WordNet serverless dictionary

scripts.generate-dict: pnpm run generate-dict:base && pnpm run generate-dict:pairs
scripts.generate-dict:pairs: node ../../../packages/wn-serverless-dict/dist/cli/index.js en-th dict-en-th --skip-if-exists && node ../../../packages/wn-serverless-dict/dist/cli/index.js en-fr dict-en-fr --skip-if-exists && node ../../../packages/wn-serverless-dict/dist/cli/index.js th-fr dict-th-fr --skip-if-exists
scripts.generate-dict:force: node ../../../packages/wn-serverless-dict/dist/cli/index.js small serverless-dict --force && node ../../../packages/wn-serverless-dict/dist/cli/index.js en-th dict-en-th --force && node ../../../packages/wn-serverless-dict/dist/cli/index.js en-fr dict-en-fr --force && node ../../../packages/wn-serverless-dict/dist/cli/index.js th-fr dict-th-fr --force
